skill_name: Explain the historical significance of the Cuban Missile Crisis.
workflow: The Cuban Missile Crisis was a major confrontation between the United States and the Soviet Union during the Cold War. It occurred in October 1962 and is considered one of the most critical moments of the Cold War due to the potential for nuclear conflict. The crisis was sparked by the discovery of Soviet-supplied nuclear missiles in Cuba, just 90 miles off the American coast.
